title: Exact restriction factors across open composition
statement:
For a scheme morphism h, an open W and an arbitrary complex I on X, Rh of the open-image localization followed by the canonical open comparison equals Rh of the open-localization unit on the termwise restriction J, followed by the canonical composition comparison at QJ, followed by the target-open derived direct image of the restricted derived direct image of the inverse exact X-restriction factor and the inverse derived restriction comparison. This equation has no h-localization unit and no underived complex-composition map. Definitions: [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMVOpenComposition_restriction_factors
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let LX := schemeOpenRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    let J := (LX.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let β := (schemeMVDirectImageComposition (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι h).symm ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg schemeDerivedDirectImage (morphismRestrict_ι h W).symm) ≪≫
      schemeMVDirectImageComposition (h ∣_ W) W.ι
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map (schemeMVOpenImageLocalization X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I) ≫
      (schemeMVOpenComparison h W (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).hom =
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map ((schemeMVDirectImageLocalization (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).app J) ≫
      β.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι).map
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ∣_ W)).map (LX.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app I) ≫
          (schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison h W).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))

proof.text: Expand the open-image localization into its unit and inverse exact source-restriction factor, and expand the canonical open comparison into the beta component and target-open direct image of the inverse restriction comparison. Apply functoriality of Rh. Naturality of beta along the inverse exact source-restriction factor moves that factor to Rj_Y R(h|W). Associate and combine the final two maps by functoriality of Rj_Y. This is the formal naturality square with a unit precomposed and an inverse comparison postcomposed.
